from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyCashPosition(BaseModel):
    """Cash and cash equivalents reported by one company in its 10-Q filing."""
    company_name: str | None = Field(description="The company name as reported in the filing")
    cash_amount: float | None = Field(description="The cash amount as numerically extracted")
    unit_scale: str | None = Field(description="The scale of the amount: 'dollars', 'thousands', or 'millions'")
    period_date: str | None = Field(description="The period end date in YYYY-MM or YYYY-MM-DD format")
    quote: str = Field(description="Verbatim line or excerpt from the filing containing the cash figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    company_cash_positions: list[CompanyCashPosition]
